subject: POC trial environment options — hosted vs dedicated vs VPC (Acme AI)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-ai.com>; Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@acme-ai.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T14:03:00Z
Subject: POC follow-up + environment options (hosted / dedicated / VPC)

Hi Jordan and Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the trial: 

Summary of discussion:
- Goals: validate inference latency at 95th pct under production-like traffic, measure per-token cost, and evaluate model quality on your internal prompt set (search & summarization flows).
- Success criteria you called out: <10% regression vs current baseline on summary ROUGE/L, 95th-pct latency < 300ms for single-turn queries, and token cost <$0.002.

POC environment options we discussed (brief):
1) Hosted Redwood API — fastest to start, no infra on your side, limited network isolation. Good if you want quick qualitative runs.
2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPU pool for Acme AI) — predictable throughput, isolated capacity, can load your model variants.
3) VPC trial (private deployment) — customer-managed networking, best for security/compliance and direct access to internal data stores. Slightly longer setup (typically 2–3 weeks).

Requested next steps (action items):
- You: confirm which environment you prefer for the initial 2-week trial (hosted vs dedicated vs VPC).
- Redwood: draft Mutual Action Plan and POC checklist, include technical onboarding steps and a timeline.
- Tech check: Dev to send minimal network/credentials checklist if VPC is chosen.

I attached a short POC checklist and will circulate a Mutual Action Plan doc for signature once we lock the option and timeline.

Proposed timeline if you pick VPC: kick off next Monday (4/19), 5 business days for network setup, 2–3 days for model onboarding and smoke tests, then 10 business days of evaluation. If hosted/dedicated, timeline compresses to ~3 business days to start.

Open items we still need to confirm:
- Final success metrics (please confirm the ROUGE / latency / cost thresholds above)
- Who on your side will own day-to-day validation (QA + SRE contact)

Thanks — I’ll loop in Soojin on the security checklist once you confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-ai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@acme-ai.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T18:06:00Z
Subject: Re: POC follow-up + environment options (hosted / dedicated / VPC)

Thanks Marissa — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Success criteria: the latency target is for our single-turn search queries (we batch some later). We'll confirm the ROUGE target tomorrow, but the token-cost budget is something we need to validate against our current monthly spend.

2) We are leaning toward a VPC trial because of our data routing policies. That said, if setup time is long we can start with a hosted smoke test for basic quality checks. Can you confirm the exact network artifacts you need (IP allowlist, VPN info, certs)?

3) Owner: Priya will own validation/QA and I’ll loop in our SRE (Hari Patel) for the VPC setup.

If you can send the Mutual Action Plan and an ETA for VPC onboarding steps, we’ll review and prioritize.

—Jordan
Director of Product, Acme AI
jordan.lee@acme-ai.com

Hi Jordan / Priya — Dev from Redwood infra. Quick technical note on VPC onboarding artifacts to make the 2-week target realistic: 

What we need from Acme for VPC trial (minimal set):
- VPN or peering details OR static IP allowlist (CIDR) for your edge/VPN termination.
- Short-lived service account for our infra agent (we provide a scoped role; principle of least privilege).
- Preferred subnet range for any private endpoints (if you want direct access to internal data stores).
- Contact for firewall/sysadmin (Hari) to coordinate connectivity windows.

If you prefer hosted first, we can provision API keys in <24 hours and provide a sample ingest pipeline for your evaluation prompts. For dedicated sandbox we'll request an estimate of concurrency and token volume so we size reserved capacity.

I’ve attached our VPC onboarding template to make it easy. Let us know if you want a short tech sync (20–30m) — we can do one tomorrow.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai

- For the initial run we want to evaluate two model variants and use our internal prompt set (Priya will share).
